title: The Molecular Structure of Thought: Mapping the Topology of Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of large language model (LLM) reasoning structures, introducing a 'molecular-like' framework and a synthesis method called MOLE-SYN. It evaluates performance on various mathematical reasoning benchmarks. While the 'Limitations' section mentions potential 'label noise or bias' in estimated distributions, this refers to technical data quality issues rather than a component of evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics in LLMs.
